'''The Flame''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gen'Dai/Legends|Gen'Dai]] resistance leader active on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. The Flame had a personal vendetta against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] for destroying the [[Gen'Dai homeworld/Legends|Gen'Dai homeworld]]. [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Sith Imperial Intelligence]] claimed to have killed him twice and yet he kept reappearing, to the point where the people of the [[Duros Sector|Duros sector]] claimed that The Flame was immortal.

==Behind the scenes==
The Flame can be killed in battle against an Imperial character for dark side points, or spared and go into exile with his followers for light side points.
